name: Button Tertiary

usage.scope: Local instances in the MNG Design System file only. Instances in other files that use the published library (WordPress Elements, Reader Dashboard v2.0) are not counted.

responsiveRules: **Desktop** (`Breakpoint=Desktop`): the inner `Button` frame hugs its label/icon (HUG horizontally) inside an 8px left/right margin wrapper. Buttons in a row or a stack keep a 16px gap.
**Mobile** (`Breakpoint=Mobile`): the inner `Button` frame fills the container width (FILL) while the wrapper keeps the 8px left/right margin. Stacked buttons use an 8px gap.
The breakpoint split is Desktop vs Mobile only; there are no per-template variants (340/768/1024/1100/1280). Use Mobile below 640px and Desktop from 640px up unless a layout says otherwise.
knownIssues: **19 of 24 variants have 0 instances** anywhere in the file: `Desktop / left / Hover`, `Desktop / left / Pressed`, `Desktop / left / InFocus`, `Desktop / right / Default`, `Desktop / right / Hover`, `Desktop / right / Pressed`, `Desktop / right / InFocus`, `Mobile / None / Default`, `Mobile / None / Hover`, `Mobile / None / Pressed`, `Mobile / None / InFocus`, `Mobile / left / Default`, `Mobile / left / Hover`, `Mobile / left / Pressed`, `Mobile / left / InFocus`, `Mobile / right / Default`, `Mobile / right / Hover`, `Mobile / right / Pressed`, `Mobile / right / InFocus`.

**4 variants are placed only in their own documentation frame** (not yet used in any real layout): `Desktop / None / Default`, `Desktop / None / Hover`, `Desktop / None / Pressed`, `Desktop / None / InFocus`.

**Inner `Button` frame height is not a uniform 40px** (spec: min-height 40px). Heights: 40px ×6, 41px ×12, 42px ×3, 46px ×3. Off-spec variants: `Desktop / None / Default` 41px; `Desktop / None / Hover` 46px; `Desktop / None / Pressed` 41px; `Desktop / left / Default` 41px; `Desktop / left / Hover` 42px; `Desktop / left / Pressed` 41px; `Desktop / right / Default` 41px; `Desktop / right / Hover` 42px; `Desktop / right / Pressed` 41px; `Mobile / None / Default` 41px; `Mobile / None / Hover` 46px; `Mobile / None / Pressed` 41px; `Mobile / left / Default` 41px; `Mobile / left / Hover` 46px; `Mobile / left / Pressed` 41px; `Mobile / right / Default` 41px; `Mobile / right / Hover` 42px; `Mobile / right / Pressed` 41px.

**Hard-coded colors not bound to a variable:** `Mobile / None / InFocus` → Frame 12963 stroke #000000; `Mobile / left / InFocus` → Frame 12963 stroke #000000. Bind them to `color/gray/black` like the other InFocus rings. Note these rings are a 2px INSIDE stroke on a padded wrapper, while Button Primary uses a 2px OUTSIDE stroke.
**Icon size is not always 16×16** (spec: 16px square). Visible icon sizes: 14×14 ×16.
